# Faizyab Hussain — Full-Stack Developer · AI Engineer · AI Product Builder

## About
Faizyab Hussain is a Full-Stack Developer, AI Engineer and AI Product Builder based in Karachi, Pakistan. He builds modern web applications, SaaS products, AI-powered tools and business systems using modern web technologies. He builds scalable AI and web systems for startups, businesses and founders.
